claim: On October 20, 2022 the SQS documentation history lists increased default quotas for FIFO high throughput mode in commercial Regions.
question: When were the SQS FIFO high throughput default quotas increased, and where do you read the current values?

values.display: Increased default quotas for FIFO high throughput mode in commercial Regions

qualifiers.scope: FIFO queues in high throughput mode, per Region
qualifiers.condition: current values are on the quotas-messages page

evidence.quote: | [FIFO high throughput limit increases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-getting-started.html#step-create-standard-queue) | Increased default quotas for FIFO high throughput mode in commercial Regions, plus FIFO high throughput document optimization. | October 20, 2022 |

note: d117. Raised again in the change feed on 2023-08-01, 2023-10-24 and 2023-11-27 (What's New pages robots-blocked; the 2022-10-19 headline says up to 6,000 TPS). Current truth: quotas-messages gives Region-dependent maximums (for example up to 70,000 TPS in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland); 2,400 TPS default elsewhere); the numbers lens holds them as sqs-fifo-ht-top-regions-70000-tps and sqs-fifo-ht-other-regions-2400-tps. Old exam material says 3,000 messages per second per FIFO queue with batching, which is still the non-high-throughput figure.
